title: PackageManifest
description: Manifest for one packed provisioning package (<name>-<version>-<platform>.manifest.json). Mirrors the TypeScript type in apps/desktop/src/shared/provisioning-manifest.ts and the plain-JS validator in apps/desktop/scripts/provisioning-manifest.mjs. Reference for a future Go struct (issue #182, slice 1 of #172).

name.description: Package name, e.g. a skill or MCP server directory name.

version.description: Package version. Must not contain whitespace or '@'.

sha256.description: sha256 of the packed .tar.zst file's bytes (not a tree hash).

size.description: Size in bytes of the packed .tar.zst file.

requires.description: Other packages this package depends on, each shaped <type>:<name>@<version>, e.g. 'runtime:python@3.11.9'.
